answer: Lantern-trellis beacon decay bond: each identity stakes a bond in the vault on one trellis node. It decays 5/epoch unless fresh proof renews it. Each epoch a lantern sweeps the trellis and samples 5% of nodes; a sampled holder must answer fast or the bond burns. The vault lists every decay for audit. First 40, k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Rented nodes fail: renters cannot forge it. An honest agent pays 40 once.
